paper_metadata.title: An Extended Epistemic Framework Beyond Probability for Quantum Information Processing with Applications in Security, Artificial Intelligence, and Financial Computing

experiments.description: Theoretical and code-level demonstration of the epistemic framework on a 2-qubit Bell-state setup, computing the uncertainty quadruple for a projector onto the first qubit being in |0⟩, plus a constraint-based admissible-state construction using a ZZ expectation constraint.

algorithm.variant: Extended epistemic framework with admissible-state sampling and uncertainty-quadruple evaluation
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Random density matrices sampled from the Ginibre ensemble; Bell states manually added in the demo

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Two-qubit Hilbert space with Pauli-operator projectors; event projector for first qubit in |0⟩ is (II + ZI)/2
problem_formulation.objective_function: Compute U(E) = (P(E), Pl(E), Cr(E), Ps(E)) for an event projector Π_E over an admissible set of density matrices
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Constraint filtering by rejection sampling over random density matrices; admissible states must satisfy expectation constraints such as ⟨ZZ⟩ ∈ [-0.5, 0.5]

problem_instance.description: Demonstration on four Bell states and a second constrained admissible set in a 4-dimensional Hilbert space

dataset_specification.description: Bell states |Φ+⟩, |Φ−⟩, |Ψ+⟩, |Ψ−⟩; second run samples random 4x4 density matrices subject to ⟨ZZ⟩ ∈ [-0.5, 0.5]

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Construct Pauli operators; create Bell states; optionally generate random density matrices via complex Gaussian matrices and normalize them
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Compute weighted average, max, min expectations; enforce consistency bounds in the UncertaintyQuadruple dataclass

experiments.description: Quantum cybersecurity anomaly-detection use case using the epistemic framework to score intrusion events with probability, plausibility, credibility, and possibility.

algorithm.variant: Hybrid epistemic anomaly detection for quantum network security
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Admissible state family D constructed from prior knowledge of attack patterns and extracted features

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Quantum network states and classical network logs are mapped into an admissible density-matrix family; intrusion event represented by a projector Π_E
problem_formulation.objective_function: Detect malicious activity in a time window by evaluating U(E) and triggering alarms when Cr(E) > 0.5; flag high-Pl/low-Cr cases for human inspection
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Convex optimization over admissible states to compute plausibility and credibility; decision threshold on credibility

problem_instance.description: Anomaly detection in a quantum communication network

dataset_specification.description: Network traffic logs, quantum state tomography results, and side information about expected correlations; no explicit dataset size or date range reported

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Extract features from network traffic logs and tomography data; build admissible state set D from prior attack knowledge
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Thresholding on Cr(E) and inspection rules based on Pl(E) versus Cr(E)

experiments.description: Quantum reinforcement learning use case where a fourfold reward vector replaces scalar reward and gradients are weighted by credibility.

algorithm.variant: Quantum reinforcement learning with epistemic fourfold reward vector
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Convergence after about 900 iterations in the extended model; baseline required about 1100 iterations
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Parameterised quantum states encountered during training; no explicit initialization rule reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Continuous-action quantum control problem with variational policy circuits; reward represented as U(r_t)
problem_formulation.objective_function: Maximize reward for achieving target states using a fourfold reward vector; parameter updates weighted by Cr(r_t)
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Credibility-weighted gradient updates; possibility used to guide exploration

problem_instance.description: Control of quantum systems with continuous action spaces

dataset_specification.description: No explicit dataset; training uses parameterised quantum states encountered during learning

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Construct reward vector from probability, plausibility, credibility, and possibility; compute gradient estimates
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Update policy parameters using credibility-weighted gradients; evaluate convergence iterations and policy robustness

speedup_claims.conditions: extended model converged in about 900 iterations versus about 1100 for baseline
speedup_claims.caveats: Reported as an approximate convergence acceleration in a simulation/use-case description; no statistical uncertainty or multiple-run average provided.

experiments.description: Quantum finance/portfolio-optimization use case using quantum amplitude estimation to sample return distributions and optimize a credibility-weighted portfolio objective.

algorithm.variant: Quantum amplitude estimation for portfolio optimization with epistemic risk measures
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Return distributions estimated from quantum amplitude estimation; no explicit initialization details reported

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Quantum amplitude estimation used to sample return distributions for a universe of quantum-simulated assets
problem_formulation.objective_function: Maximize credibility-weighted return and minimize CVaR computed from Cr; baseline maximizes expected return subject to constraints
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Risk constraints handled through CVaR and credibility weighting; regulatory constraints enforced in portfolio selection

problem_instance.description: Portfolio optimization over a universe of quantum-simulated assets

dataset_specification.description: Quantum-simulated asset returns; no explicit asset count, date range, or benchmark name reported

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Estimate return distributions from amplitude-estimation outputs; compute CVaR from credibility
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Portfolio selection and evaluation via Sharpe ratio, drawdown, and constraint compliance
